Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
STATE / GOALS: Latest confirmed turn 32. Early settlement/exploration; no explicit victory objective. Settler and recovered Eagle Warrior now share a tile east/near the eastern border of Tenochtitlan and are in a CONFIRMED escort formation. Warrior had 1/2 movement after rendezvous. Last completed action left-clicked presumed Settler banner at (0.439,0.512) to select it and display settlement overlay; resulting selection/screenshot NOT yet observed. Second-city destination undecided. Writing 1 turn remaining, Foreign Trade 2. Continue evaluating settlement site and escort travel, research, production and exploration. Screenshots omitted; facts below derive from recorded descriptions, with uncertainties retained.

CONTROLS / TIMING: Pointer without button hovers; left-click selects; right-click ground moves or attacks enemy. Right-click friendly unit BANNER can select that unit instead of moving the selected unit: use tile ground for rendezvous. Hover enemies for combat preview. Adjacent enemy right-click worked for melee and Slinger ranged fire. Cyan boundary indicates reachable tiles. Unit portrait click confirmed recentering camera. Minimap click around (.063,.851) returned to capital; view/zoom changes all map coordinates. Scroll negative zooms out; scrolling over map zoomed even with report open. Lower-right prompts at x~.934, y~.730 or .884: Choose Research/Production/Civic, Unit Needs Orders, Next Turn, Please Wait. All explicit Unit Needs Orders clicks in supplied history were rejected stale_observation; cycling remains unverified and subsequent auto-selections cannot be attributed to those clicks. Numerous waits/hovers/clicks similarly rejected during animations, not proof of invalid commands. Counters often update before figures arrive. Next Turn can select/resolve outstanding units or queued movement instead of advancing; displayed availability does not prove all movement spent. Please Wait alone is not a new turn. T23 apparent processing returned to Builder/Scout orders while still T23. Completion popups red X; boost popups Continue; Escape successfully closed policy screen. Tech icon upper-left closes tree.

ESCORT / SETTLER: Settler completed T30, 2/2 movement in capital. Selected its banner to get colored water-availability overlay. Green tiles northeast and south seen at wider zoom. NE candidate inspected: Desert (Hills) beside river, cost 2 movement, 1 Production; at then-current zoom (.766,.382), northwest of old fortified warrior near wheat. River access observed; suitability beyond that not assessed. Settler ordered toward warrior T30, exhausted movement and left city but did not arrive; dashed queued route later ended in woods east of warrior. Warrior selected separately, full-looking green health, 2/2. Right-clicking Settler banner selected Settler without moving warrior; subsequent southwest ground move consumed warrior's 2 movement. T31 redirection/rendezvous attempts left them close but not together; selection/movement changes partly ambiguous (warrior later showed 0/2). T32 warrior right-clicked ground of adjacent SW Settler tile, spent 1 movement. Chain icon appeared; hover explicitly 'Create Escort Formation with Settler'. Click (.703,.744) completed; next tooltip 'Exit Escort Formation' confirms link. Actual movement of linked pair not yet tested. Last action attempted selecting Settler as above.

CITY / PRODUCTION: Tenochtitlan founded beside river; Found City then Yes to remove Rainforest. Population 1 initially, 2 T9, 3 T13, 4 T19 and T30. Use Production tab, not Purchase. Scout completed T8; Slinger T13; first Builder T19. Monument selected T19 (4 turns, +2 Culture, cost60), completion confirmed T23. Settler selected T23 (8-turn estimate), completed T30. T30 Builder available 5 turns, tooltip 3 improvements; first click rejected, second completed and panel closed. Capital later displayed 5-turn production indicator consistent with Builder, but item/queue not explicitly rechecked. Housing T30 4/7. No later Builder completion observed.

IMPROVEMENTS: First Builder 3 charges. Farm southwest of capital T19: +1 Food, .5 Housing; fields confirmed. Initial cattle interpretation there was corrected: white icon was farm recommendation, resource unknown. Mine west of first farm completed by T21, Wheel Eureka; T22 Builder on mine with 2/2 movement and 1 charge. Ordered toward wheat NE of capital within borders; exhausted movement and later arrived with 1/2 and 1 charge on T23. Hover confirmed Farm +1 Food/.5 Housing; build completed. Craftsmanship Inspiration and Irrigation Eureka ('resource farmed') both confirmed. All 3 charges used; no need for further improvement for Craftsmanship.

RESEARCH / CIVICS: Mining T11, Animal Husbandry T17, Pottery T23 completed. Writing selected via tech tree T23: blue numbered1 marker, initially10 turns, Library and Campus unlocks. Campus adjacency from mountains and pairs of rainforest observed in earlier tooltip. Writing boost condition Meet another civilization; not boosted when selected. Counts: T24 9, T25 7, T26 6, T27 5, T28 4, T29 3, T30 and31 2, T32 1; don't assume fixed decrement. Code of Laws T15. Discipline (+5 vs Barbarians) and Urban Planning (+1 production all cities) dragged into military/economic slots, Confirm Policies then Yes; enacted. Craftsmanship selected T15; third improvement boosted T23, completed T24. Inspected new Agoge (specified combat-unit production) and Ilkum (Builders); neither lists Settlers; kept existing policies and exited Escape. Foreign Trade selected T24, confirmed10 turns; unlocks Trade Routes, Trader, Caravansaries, Maritime Industries. Boost discover second continent not confirmed. Alternatives then Military Tradition6, State Workforce17. Earlier boosts: Astrology from Torres Del Paine T10; Military Tradition outpost clear T15; Political Philosophy contacts with other states T18; Archery Slinger kill T19; Wheel mine T21; Irrigation wheat farm T23. Astrology/Archery not researched. Earlier memory mentioned Brussels Campus quest, but quest details not verified in supplied observations.

WARRIOR / COMBAT: Eagle Warrior base28, 2 moveme
